title: verify.rs: message-digest comparison is not constant-time
description: In check_message_digest(), the comparison 'if expected_bytes != content_hash' uses Vec<u8> PartialEq, which is not constant-time. For a MAC-like check in a non-interactive library (offline signature verification), timing side-channels are not exploitable in practice (no timing oracle is exposed to an attacker). However security reviewers may flag this. Consider using subtle::ConstantTimeEq for the digest comparison. This is a low-practical-risk item but worth noting for security audits.
